title: Pure Ritual Beast
summary: Ritual Beast cards only, with generic staples. A Ritual Beast Tamer and a Spiritual Beast banish themselves to become a Contact Fusion Ritual Beast Ulti, and the Ultis return to the Extra Deck on either turn to bring both halves back from banishment. Each Ritual Beast monster can only be Special Summoned once per turn, so the deck leans on extra Normal Summons: Ritual Beast Tamer Elder grants one, and Lara and Wen revive a Ritual Beast from the GY or banishment when Normal Summoned. The 2024 cards lead. Spiritual Beast Tamer Lara discards itself for an extra Normal Summon and, when banished, summons a Ritual Beast from the Deck. Ritual Beast Inheritance searches a Ritual Beast of a different Type. Ritual Beast Ulti-Nochiudrago keeps your other Ritual Beasts from being targeted, and Ulti-Reirautari stops both players from tributing.
